initialization: All three public networks inherit the identical L1 checkpoint. New channel residual logits initialize at zero; source gates start at1, cross gates at the inherited scalar. Encoder/DEMON/normalization remain frozen. No external weights.
training: Only public TabM including first-layer projections, gates, hidden blocks, set and count heads trains. Same cached L1 wave views, batches, dropout draws, weights, seed13 and optimizer budget across arms. Maximum60 epochs, minimum20, shared patience15.
training_views: One original Train view with existing Single envelopes; two independent AWGN draws for each 10,5,0,-5,-10dB. Weak-SNR Single uses the stored unenveloped waveform. Each epoch samples the original six-condition probability distribution and one of the two cached noise variants, identically across arms. No noisy waveform dataset is saved. This finite shared diagnostic bank differs from R0 online epoch-specific noise draws.
selection: Exclude epoch0. Rank trained checkpoints by [all original Val S/D no more than1pp below L1, background no more than one extra error and -10ACC>=55; original mean(S,D,ACC); originalACC; -10ACC]. Seal each arm selection before Test.
prediction: Seven-set logits plus a learned count residual. Mean32 member softmax, full seven-set argmax; no true quantity, source, ship label or SNR input.
interpretation: Controlled warm-start test of cross-channel versus source-channel selection on fixed L1 representations. Finite training-view bank matches across arms; it is not a new replay of historic online-noise encoder training.
